tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yi dam sgrub skor 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i za ma tog ces bya ba bzhugs/

rab 'byams dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gtso/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs btud nas/ /sgrub thabs rim pa phyogs gcig bri/ /thog mar bla ma dang rdo rje 'chang zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang gi mdun nam spyi bor seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i steng du sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdor dril bzung nas yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug mar 'khyud pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ mtshan dpes spras shing*/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur par bsam la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /zhes sogs dang*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ /zhes sogs kyis phyag bya/ bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa las/ /byung ba'i phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /sna tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum sogs kyis mchod pa dang maṇḍal 'bul/ de nas yan lag lhag ma byed na/ thog med nas bsags sdig ltung so sor bshags/ /rang gzhan dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang*/ /zab dang rgya che'i 'khor lo bskor tu gsol/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs/ /dge kun rdo rje 'chang dbang thob phyir bsngo/ /gsol 'debs ni/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/

/dam chos kun 'dus= 'phags tshogs kun 'dus= skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud la nges 'byung byang chub kyi sems yang dag pa'i lta ba dang rim pa gnyis kyi lam rnams myur du skye bar byin gyis brlob tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum sogs ci rigs shugs drag tu brjod/ de ltar gsol btab bla ma'i gnas gsum las/ /'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang*/ /cig car byung nas bdag gi gnas gsum du/ /rim dang cig car thim nas sgrib bzhi dag /dbang bzhi thob nas sku bzhi'i nus pa bzhag /dgyes bzhin rang gi spyi bor byon nas kyang*/ /snying ga'i padmo'i dbus su brtan par bzhugs/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/ /zhes sogs kyang brjod par bya'o/ /'jigs byed kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sna tshogs pad nyi'i steng*/ /yi dam kun 'dus 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed/ /sku mdog sngon po zhal dgu phyag so bzhi/ /khro bo'i nyams rdzogs phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin/ /bcu drug zhabs ldan dregs pa brdzis pa'i steng*/ /g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskum yum dang bcas pa'i skur/ /yongs gyur rdo rje gsum mtshan hūṃ yig las/ /'od 'phros rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra ba'i/ /rgyal ba kun dngos 'jigs mdzad rdo rje ni/ /sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha tshogs dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung tshogs dang bcas/ /spyan drangs dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus gshin rje gshed po la/ /grangs med lus sprul sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /ji snyed phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs bcas te 'bul/ / thog med dus nas sgo gsum gyis bsags pa'i/ /sdig ltung nyes pa'i tshogs rnams so sor bshags/ /rang gzhan skye 'phags kun gyi rnam dkar la/ / bsam pa thag pas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa ji bzhin du/

/zab dang rgya che'i chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /'gro kun don phyir 'khor ba ma stongs par/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ / 'dis mtshon ji snyed mchis pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /bla ma mchog gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /yi dam bstan srung tshogs dang bcas pa yi/ /skyabs mchog kun 'dus rdo rje 'jigs byed la/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gi phyi nang 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*/ /mthun rkyen ma lus lhun gyis 'grub pa sogs/ / mdor na mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlob tu gsol/ / zhes pa lan gsum sogs brjod la/ de nas de ltar gsol ba btab pas gnas gsum las/ /bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang*/ /cig car byung nas bdag gi gnas gsum du/ /thim pas sgrib bzhi dag nas dbang bzhi thob/ /sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba'i nus pa bzhag / dgyes bzhin bdag gi spyi bor byon nas kyang*/ /thim pas byin rlabs rang nyid skad cig gis/ /'jam dpal gshin rje gshed du gsal bar gyur/ /bar bsam la sngags gsum ci 'grub bzlas nas/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon bya'o// rje bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i steng*/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med pa'i/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rgyal ba blo bzang grags/ /dkar dmar mdangs ldan dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal can/ /chos 'khor phyag rgyas utpal ge sar steng*/ /ye shes ral gri sher phyin glegs bam bsnams/ /ngur smrig chos gos gser mdog paṇa zhwa gsol/ /skyil krung tshul gyis 'od kyi gur khyim dbus/ /gsal rdzogs mtshan dang dpe byad dpal gyis mdzes/ /zab dang rgya che'i dam pa'i chos sgra sgrogs/ / dri med mkhyen dang brtse ba'i gter gyur pa/ /gdul bya'i dpal du lham mer bzhugs pa yi/

/gnas gsum rdo rje gsum mtshan 'od zer gyis/ /rgyal ba sras bcas tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa/ /spyan drangs thim pas kun 'dus bdag nyid gyur/ /shes bya kun la thogs med 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mar gyur spyan ras gzigs/ / ma lus bdud dpung 'joms mdzad gsang ba'i bdag /rigs gsum kun 'dus bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ /srid zhi'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul nam mkha' gang ba dang*/ /bdag lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ /rje btsun bla ma 'khor bcas mnyes phyir 'bul/ /thog med nas bsags sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ / rang gzhan rnam dkar kun la rjes yi rang*/ /'gro la bskal brgyar chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /nam mkha' ji srid bar du brtan par bzhugs/ /'dis mtshon dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zhes yan lag bdun pa byas nas/ dmigs brtse ma bzla/ de nas/ skyabs gsum kun 'dus bla ma rin po che/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs te/ /rdzogs byang myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum de ltar gsol bas bla ma'i gnas gsum las/ /bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum rim can dang*/ /cig car byung thim sgrib byang dbang bzhi thob/ /sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba'i nus ldan gyur/ /bla ma dgyes bzhir rang gi spyi bor byon/ /'od kyi gong bur gyur te spyi gtsug nas/ /snying ga'i rlung sems shin tu phra ba la/ /thim pas 'dres te byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ /tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba btsong kha pas/ /zhes sogs kyang brjod do/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lta bu'i skyabs 'gro rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du btang nas/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ yab rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dza: oṃ badzra satwa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ pañtsa kū las mchod pa'am/ min kyang rung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa'/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim par gyur par bsam la/ dmigs pa dang bcas te yig brgya nyer gcig sogs bzla'o/ /mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yi/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/

/'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /las sgrib thams cad sbyang du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ zhal gyis bzhes nas/ rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur par bsam la bsngo smon ci rigs bya'o// ngan 'gro 'joms mdzad mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ skyab sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ sngon 'gro tshogs zhing byas na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur yang*/ ma byas kyang chad lhag tu mi 'gyur bas/ 'jug pa bde ba'i ched sgrub thabs kyi dngos gzhi nas dgod par bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig mthing shun gyi mdog lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi ngan 'gror skye ba'i rgyu las sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po dbu gtsug tor dang ldan zhing*/ sham thabs dang chos gos gsol ba/ sprul sku'i cha byad can/ g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ mchod pa yod na byin gyis brlab la/ oṃ badzra akṣo bhyaḥ sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta pra titstsha'i bar gyis mchod/ chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thugs rjes rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub lhur mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsams la sngar ltar mchod bstod bya ba'am/ mi byed kyang*/ thugs ka'i zla gdan gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi las kyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas sngags 'phreng la thim par bsam la/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarb+ba karmā pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarb+ba satwā nāñtsa swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mjug tu yig brgya brjod/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang nyer bsdu byas te langs pa'am/ ma byas kyang mi 'gal zhing*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mi 'khrugs rgyal po 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs bsngo smon dang shis brjod bya'o// sangs rgyas sman bla ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rgyal ba sman gyi bla sku mdog bai ḍūrya sngon po ltar dwangs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dug gsum 'joms pa'i a ru ra dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas sman gyis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'od zer gyi phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rgyal ba sman gyi bla ma la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ nas dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur par bsam/ oṃ gu ru bai ḍūrya arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ / bai ḍūrya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsam la/ tadya thā/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye bhe ṣa dzye/ ma hā bai ṣa dzye bai ṣa dzye rā dzā sa muṅga te swāhā/ ci nus dang*/ ghu me ghu me sogs bzlas na'ang phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ mthar yig brgya dang mchod bstod byas nas dge ba 'di yis sogs kyi bsngo smon bya'o// klu dbang gtso 'khor lnga ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hūṃ yig sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhal dang mgrin pa dung ltar dkar ba/ phyag gnyis dam tshig gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ chos gos mdzes par gsol zhing*/ mtshan dpes spras pa sprul gyi gdengs ka'i rgyab yol can/

'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mdun du byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel dkar po rin po che'i myu gu dang bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yas su byams pa dmar po klu shing gi me tog dang ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa/ rgyab tu 'jam dpal ser po utpal bsnams pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dkar po padma bsnams pa/ bzhi ka'ang pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' dang g.yon du dgra bcom/ 'og phyogs su klu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'khod pa/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ bha ga wan nā gend+ra rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gi mtshan tsam bzung pas kyang*/ /myong nges las kyi sgrib pa dang*/ /klu nad ma lus zhi mdzad pa/ /klu yi dbang phyug rgyal por bstod/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ 'di sogs phal cher la dbang lha spyan 'dren ma mdzad pa ltar bkod/ de nas/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi las sgrib dang*/ khyad par klu las gyur pa'i nad dang gdon sogs zhi bar byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la tadya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga tā bha ga wan nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas te/ yig brgyas brtan par byas la mchod bstod bya/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon shis brjod kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /ngan song sbyong ba'i rnam snang ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du 'gro bas/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan la oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rnam snang dkar po zhal bzhi dkar ba/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas 'khor lo bsnams pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ bdag nyid kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod pa yod na brlab la/ oṃ bai ro tsa na arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can/ /rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i oṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi ngan song gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa zhi bar byas/ 'od zer slar 'dus nas rang nyid la thim par bsam la/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes ci nus dang gzungs ring kyang bzla/ de ltar byas na ngan song myong nges kyi las sgrib 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /mthar yig brgya bzlas nas/ mchod bstod bsdus pa dang*/ bsngo smon ci rigs bya'o/ /shāka thub ni/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ pad zla'i gdan la muṃ ser po/ de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa sku gser btso ma'i mdog ltar ser ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas lhung bzed bsnams pa/ mtshan dpes spras shing*/ sku la chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/

'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rgyal ba shākya thub pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ shākya mu ne sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod la/ thabs mkhas thugs rje mas bstod/ dza:hūṃ baṃ hoḥrang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i zla gdan gyi steng du muṃ yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi tshogs zhi zhing bde ba dang ldan par byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs thams cad drangs te rang nyid la thim par bsam la tadya thā/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas la/ yig brgya brjod pa sogs bya'o/ /'od dpag med ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po sprul sku'i cha byad can/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ 'od kyi tshogs mtha' yas 'phro ba'i dbus na rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i/ spyi bor oṃ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ bde ba can nas mgon po 'od dpag med la rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ padma dha ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ thugs bskyed smon lam dag pa'i mthus/ /ma dag snyigs ma'i 'gro ba kun/ /dag pa'i zhing du 'dren pa'i dpal/ /'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dza:hūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/

rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi byin rlabs mtha' dag bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsam la/ oṃ padma dha ra hrīḥswāhā/ zhes ci nus dang*/ tadya thā/ oṃ a mi te/ a mi te ud bha we/ a mi ta sambha ba/ a mi ta bi krānte/ a mi ta gā mi ni/ ga ga na kīrti ka re sarba gle sha kṣa yaṃ ka ri swāhā/ zhes bzlas na phan yon dpag tu med par bshad do/ /mthar yig brgya bzla/ 'dod na/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur par bsam la/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa dang*/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing sogs smon lam byas na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur la bsdu na/ gong gi mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yis sogs smon lam ci rigs bya'o// tshe dpag med ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras shing dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i dbus na rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas hūṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba nas yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ārya a pa ra mi ta a yur dzñā na arghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ / sogs kyis bstod/

rang gi thugs kar zla gdan gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi tshe mi ma yin gyis 'phrog pa dang*/ snod bcud kyi nus pa'i yon tan rnams rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs dang lhan cig tu 'od dang bdud rtsi dmar ser gyi rnam par bsdus nas bkug ste sngags 'phreng la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag tshe dang bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wanti ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus dang*/ gzungs ring kyang bzla/ mthar yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ dge ba 'di yis sogs dang*/ dus min 'chi ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba na/ /zhes sogs bsngo smon bkra shis kyis brgyan par bya'o// byams pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings su seng ge'i khri'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon po sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis spyi blugs kyis mtshan pa'i klu shing gi sdong po bsnams pa/ dbu la thub pa'i ngo bo byang chub mchod rten gyis mdzes pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ zhabs gnyis bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros dga' ldan la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun byams pa mgon po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ byams chen me yis zhes sogs kyis bstod cing*/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun byams pa mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/

/mchod do/ /skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum mam bdun sogs dang*/ ji snyed mchod pa'i tshogs ma lus pa 'bul lo/ /sdig ltung thams cad bshags so/ /dge ba la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor bar bskul lo/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' bar rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ dge ba kun kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /de nas/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid rje btsun byams pa mgon po la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag la byin gyis brlob tu gsol/ zhes ci nus brjod pa'i mthar/ dgyes bzhin rang la thim pas rang nyid kyang rje btsun byams mgon gyi skur gyur par bsam la/ oṃ ārya mai tri swāhā/ ci nus dang*/ gzungs ring kyang bzlas na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /'di yi dge bas sogs kyis smon lam bya'o// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dmar ser ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang*/ tshogs zhing byed na/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'jam dbyangs su bskyed/ sa bon las 'od zer spros te tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa tsam mam/ yan lag bdun pa byas la tshad med bzhi bsgom pa spyi ltar bya/ dngos gzhi ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i snying sgo nga lta bu'i rtse mo gyen du bstan pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rgyas pa'i steng du dhīḥyig dmar ser tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib rmongs pa dang bcas pa dag /'od zer phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnams mchod cing de dag gi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas rang la thim/ rang nyid pad zla'i gdan la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon utpa la'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha phye ba'i steng na sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/

rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ dpung brgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ lha rdzas kyi dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ ral pa'i zur phud g.yon du spud pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams ldan/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ 'di 'jam dbyangs chos skor nas 'byung ba ltar yin pas dbang bskur rgyas 'debs ma byas la/ sa paṇa nas brgyud pa la dbang bskur rgyas 'debs snang ngo*/ /oṃ ārya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ gzhon nu'i cha lugs sogs dang*/ spro na/ mtshams sprin gzhon nu mas bstod/ de nas/ rang gi thugs kar zla gdan gyi steng du dhīḥyig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas sogs kyi byin rlabs dang shes rab kyi snang ba thams cad bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsam la/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes ci nus dang*/ mthar yig brgya bzla zhing*/ mchod bstod bya ba'am/ spro na/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas zhal rang la phyogs te bzhugs par gyur ces brjod la/ yan lag bdun pa'am/ mchod bstod gsol 'debs ci rigs bya/ dge ba 'di yis sogs dang/ brtse ldan khyod kyis sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun la dmigs pa yi/ /zhes sogs bsngo smon kyang bya'o/ /'jam dbyangs dkar po ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ baṃ las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dwangs shing gsal ba padmo'i tshal gyis khyab cing*/

mtha' ne'u sing gis bskor ba la glang chen thal dkar mche ba drug ldan du ma dal gyis rgyu ba/ mtsho'i dbus su pad dkar 'dab stong ldan pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid a dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas bzung ba'i utpa la'i steng du shes rab kyi ral gri dang*/ g.yon chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas bzung ba'i pad dkar snyan thad du kha bye ba'i steng na sher phyin gyi glegs bam bsnams pa/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tsho can/ zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams ldan/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ nas hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyis gnas nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkar po la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ dza:hūṃ baṃ hoḥ slar yang nas spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis nas yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /mchod pa yod na byin gyis rlabs la/ oṃ ārya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar glegs bam ral gris phyag mtshan zhing*/ /rab mdzes shin tu zhi ba'i gzhon nu zur phud lnga ldan pa/ /dga' ba rgya chen thar mchog spyan ni padma'i 'dab ltar yangs/ /blo gros ngan pa sreg mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang gi snying kar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa mu khyud dang bcas pa/ lte bar zla ba'i steng du a dkar po/ rtsibs drug la yig drug gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/

mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi blo gros spob pa thams cad bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ oṃ wa kyai daṃ na maḥ zhes bzla/ de'i tshe 'khor lo g.yas dang yig drug g.yon du 'khor ba lta bu'i dmigs pa dang*/ mjug tu yig brgya bzlas nas bsngo smon bya/ gtor ma 'bul na/ 'og nas thun mong du 'byung ba ltar bya/ ma sha'i sbyor ba ni gzhan las shes par bya'o// spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa ni/ skyabs sems sogs byas la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas shel phreng dang*/ g.yon 'og mas padma dkar po 'dzin pa/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ ri dwags kṛṣṇa sa ra'i pags pa nu ma g.yon pa la bkab pa/ 'ja' zer 'khrugs pa'i 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ po ta la nas spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ nas 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ mchod pa yod na byin rlabs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ oṃ ārya lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs kar zla gdan gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar yig drug gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ rigs drug gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa sbyangs te 'phags pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim/ snang ba sku'i khyer so/ /grag stong gsung gi khyer so/ /dran rtogs thugs kyi khyer so ste 'khyer so gsum dang ldan par gyur par bsam la/ yig drug ci nus bzlas nas yig brgya brjod pa sogs bya'o// 'di la brten nas ril sgrub byed na/ dam rdzas ldan pa'i ril bu mtshal gyi na bza' can gsher thag chod pa bum pa ci tsam 'dod pa'i nang du blugs/ mgul bcings dang gzungs thag btags pa stegs kyi khar bzhag la mdun du mchod gtor bshams pa sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len shes par bya/ sgrub tshul la ni/ rgyal dbang lnga bas mdo sngags kyi phyogs gnyis gsungs kyang*/ sngags kyi skabs dang sbyar ba ni 'jug pa bde zhing*/ de la dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas kha skong dang bcas pa'i ril sgrub kyi cho ga gnang ba 'di/ deng sang dar so che bas 'dir de dang bstun nas kha 'gengs 'os pas kha bkang*/ gab dbugs bsal te/ phyag len mthong brgyud ltar bri bar bya'o/ /de yang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum zhes pa nas/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dpal mgon= mchi'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa lan gsum sogs brjod/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum/ tshogs zhing dang bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa thun mong du byin brlab bya ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen por gyur/

oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod sprin sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar/ oṃ badzra sa mā dza: 'dir khrus gsol byed na/ ma lus ma sogs spyan 'dren dang*/ khrus gsol kyang rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun/ yang na/ yan lag bdun pa tsam dang*/ bsdu na/ oṃ ārya lo ki shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha sogs kyis mchod la/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas bdag mdun gnyis las/ dang po ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo hrīḥdakar po nas/ mjug gi mchod bstod kyi bar bya'o// gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ bum pa'am ril sgrub mdzad par zhu zhes snyan gsan phab nas/ bum pa a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bum pa gnyis sogs yod na stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ bhruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa phyi bum pa la nang gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i dbus su ril bu rnams mi dmigs par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrī:las padma hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs nas/ rgyas 'debs kyi bar bya/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ chu bo gaṅgā ma dang*/ chos dbyings rnam dag ma sogs kyi tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas phul te/

skyon gyis ma gos sogs tshigs bcad gcig gam/ spro na/ rab dkar chu skyes bzhad pa'i lte ba la/ /zla ba zhun mar 'khyil ba'i gdan steng du/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i zlos gar can/ / 'jig med rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gag pa med pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi gdangs/ /zab don dam pa'i chos su nyer 'char ba'i/ /skal bzang rna ba'i bdud rtsi bla na med/ /yan lag drug cu'i gsung la= skye 'gag gnas bral gdod nas stong pa'i dbyings/ /'gyur ba med pa bde chen chos sku'i klong*/ /ma bsgribs shes bya thams cad kun gzigs pa'i/ /zag med ye shes thugs la= /ma 'dres kun la mdza' ba'i bshes gyur kyang*/ /dus mthar bod kyi lha skal 'jig rten dbang*/ /thugs rje chen po 'khor bcas khyed rnams kyis/ / bdag sogs phan bde'i dpal la 'god par mdzod/ /zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas bum pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs nus pa thams cad bsdus nas lha so so la thim par bsam la/ yig drug bzla' 'o/ /thun mthar yig brgya bzla/ mchod bstod byas la/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /gdung shugs drag pos thugs rje'i rgyud bskul na/ /dam rdzas ril bu 'di la byin rlabs la/ /'gro rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum dang*/ rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i byed po yis/ /'phags pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang la sogs pa/ /skyabs gnas kun gyi byin rlabs nus mthu'i tshogs/ /'od dang 'od zer bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang*/ /'phags pa'i sku 'i rnam par thogs med bsdus/ /ril bu thugs rje chen po'i rnam pa la/ /chu la chu bzhag bzhin du ro gcig gyur/ /ces brjod/ gtor ma gsum las/

dang po ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ 'phags pa'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ ārya lo ke shwa ra sa pā ri wā ra i daṃ sogs kyis lan gsum du phul nas mchod bstod bya/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa chos skyong dang gzhi bdag gi gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la spyi ltar phul nas/ yig brgya lan gsum brjod de/ ma rnyed sogs

kyis ba zod gsol dang*/ 'dir ni gzugs dang zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod bya/ grol ba'i nyin par/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhes sogs kyi/ gsol 'debs ni/ bzod gsol gyi mjug tu blangs la/ rkang pa tha ma gnyis/ ril bu thugs rje chen por gsal ba rnams/ /'od zhu gnyis su med par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas ril bu lha'i rnam par bzhugs pa rnams 'od du zhu nas ril bu'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor te/ bsngo smon sogs bya/ nyer bsdu ma byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /byed na bdag bskyed kyi mjug tu'ang rung la/ 'dir byed na/ su pra tiṣṭha'i mjug tu rang lhar gsal ba 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ de nyid kyang hrīḥl thim/ de ra btags la thim/ ra btags khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo gi gu la thim/ gi gu nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen por gyur/ ces brjod de bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o/ /de ltar sgrub pa'i ril bu ni mos pa drag pos longs spyad na rgyud la lha'i byin rlabs zhugs te las sgrib 'dags shing rten bzang po 'grub pa dang 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i nus pa 'jog pa sogs kyi rten 'brel khyad par can yod do/ / 'dir bcu gcig zhal gyi mngon rtogs dang sbyar ba'i smyung gnas kyi cho ga mdor bsdus paṇa chen dang rgyal dbang gi gsung las byung ba la cung zad kha bkang ste 'jug pa bde bar bri bar bya'o/ /de yang*/ dkyil 'khor 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir sku'am tshom bu dgod/ bum rdzas dang ldan pa'i bum pa mgul 'ching can 'o ma can gyi shing gis brgyan pa dang*/ maṇḍal/ mchod pa/ gtor ma gsum sogs sta gon bya/ nyams len la spyor dngos mjug gsum las/ dang po ni/

thog mar langs nas padma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ padma ud bha wa ye swāhā/ zhes brjod de khrus bya/ gso sbyong ni bla ma'am/ rten gyi drung du len na sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi 'du shes bzhag la phyag btsal nas maṇḍal rgyas bsdus ci rigs phul te/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun du sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka'/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang*/ phan par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges par rtogs par bya ba'i phyir gso sbyong yang dag par mdzad pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du gso sbyong yang dag par blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum/ deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing*/ /gzhan gyi nor ni blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyad cing*/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer brten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri stan che mtho mi bya zhing*/ /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar/ /de bzhin srog gcod la sogs spang*/ /bla med byang chub myur thob shog /sdug bsngal mang 'khrugs 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'don par shog

/ces lan gcig brjod la/ oṃ a mo gha shī la sambha ra sambha ra/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā shungngha satwa/ padma bi bhu ṣi ta bhu dza/ dha ra dha ra/ sa manta a ba lo ke te hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs nyer gcig bzla'o/ /de nas/ skyabs 'gro sogs byas la/ rang nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen por gyur/ mchod pa a mraṃ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhuṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ las mchod pa rnams lha mi'i mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ yang na so sor byin gyis brlabs/ tshogs zhing ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ thugs rje chen po la sogs pa bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ bsdu na/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod de/ phyag stong sogs kyis bstod/ cung zad spro na mchod pa bzhag pas bstod pa de nyid kyi mthar/ ḍā ki'i gtso mo dpal ldan dpal mo'i zhabs/ /zhes sogs ci rigs kyis phyag btsal te/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa'ang bya/ bshags pa'i tshe ltung bshags sogs byed na skabs dang sbyar/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag mdun gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mchod pa sngar ma brlabs na 'dir bya/ bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ lha drug bskyed dang tshar gsum bskyed dgos bshad kyang*/ 'dir 'jug pa bde ched 'di bzhin du bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa pas rang nyid thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas ljang g.yon dmar/ de'i steng ma dbus ljang*/ g.yas dmar g.yon dkar/ de'i steng ma dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar g.yon ljang*/ de'i steng du khro zhal nag po/ de'i steng du zhi zhal dmar po gtsug tor can/

phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na bgrang phreng*/ gsum pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ bzhi pa na 'khor lo/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na padma/ gsum pa na spyi blugs/ bzhi pa na mda' gzhu/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po thams cad kyang mchog sbyin mdzad pa'i mthil na spyan re re/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ thugs rje chen po la sangs rgyas nas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas yongs su gyur pa las rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ārya lo ke shwa ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la bstod/ de nas/ rang gi thugs kar zla gdan la ye shes sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hrīḥdakar po/ de'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bkrug nas rang nyid la thim par bsams te/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma ārya dzñā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byā ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥsarb+ba ta thā ga te bhyaḥ arhad bhyaḥ sam myaksaṃ buddhe bhyaḥ na maḥ.ārya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tatya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭṭe waṭṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma wa re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dzwa la ma bā na ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan gcig dang*/ tatya thā man brgya dang bdun te brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ yig drug la gtso bor 'bad/ yig brgya bzlas nas mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ sgrub gzhi la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ rang gi thugs ka'i hriḥlas bhruṃ dkar po zhig mdun du chad/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ bhruṃ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥyig dkar po/ de las 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dbus su thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal/ zhes pa nas/ stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i shar du hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sngon po/ lhor trāṃ las rin 'byung ser po/ nub tu oṃ las rnam snang dkar po/ byang du āḥlas don grub ljang khu rnams rang rang gi phyag rgya can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas rgyas 'debs kyi bar bya/ mchod pa brlabs la/ oṃ ārya lo ki shwa rā sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ spro na tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas 'bul/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du zhes sogs kyis bstod/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i phyag mdzub las bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod la/ mdun bskyed dang bum pa gnyis thun mong du gzungs ring thung ci rigs bzla/ de nas bo bstod ni/ oṃ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten bla ma srid pa gsum gyis bstod pa po/ /lha yi gtso bo bdud dang tshangs pas bstod pa po/ /thub pa'i rgyal mchog bstod pas grub par mdzad pa po/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs dpag med sku ste sku bzang 'dzin pa po/ /bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas dbu rgyan 'dzin pa po/ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin yi dwags bkres skom sel ba po/ /phyag g.yon gser gyi padmas rnam par brgyan pa po/ /dri zhim ral pa'i phreng ba dmar ser 'khyug pa po/ /zhal ras rgyas pa zla ba lta bur mdzes pa po/ /spyan ni padma mchog tu bzang zhing yangs pa po/

kha ba dung ltar rnam dag dri ngad ldan pa po/ /dri med 'od chags mu tig tshom bu 'dzin pa po/ /mdzes pa'i 'od zer skya rengs dmar pos brgyan pa po/ / padma'i mtsho ltar phyag ni dngar bar byas pa po/ /ston ka'i sprin gyi mdog dang ldan zhing gzhon pa po/ /rin chen mang pos dpung ba gnyis ni brgyan pa po/ lo ma'i mchog ltar phyag mthil gzhon zhing 'jam pa po/ /ri dwags pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa po/ /snyan cha gdu bus sgeg cing rgyan rnams 'chang ba po/ / dri ma med pa padma'i mchog la gnas pa po/ /lte ba'i ngos ni padma'i 'dab ltar 'jam pa po/ /gser gyi ske rags mchog la nor bus spras pa po/ /sta zur dkris pa'i ras bzang sham thabs 'dzin pa po/ /thub pa'i mkhyen mchog mtsho chen pha rol phyin pa po/ /mchog brnyes bsod nams mang po nye bar bsags pa po/ /rtag tu bde ba'i 'byung gnas rga nad sel ba po/ /gsum mthar mdzad cing mkha' spyod spyod pa ston pa po/ /lus can mchog ste bdud dpung 'khrug las rgyal ba po/ /gser gyi rkang gdub sgra yis zhabs yid 'ong ba po/ /tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi yis dben par mdzad pa po/ /ngang ba'i 'gros 'dra glang chen dregs ltar gshegs pa po/ /yongs rdzogs nye bar bsags shing bstan pa gnyer ba po/ /'o ma'i mtsho dang chu yi mtsho las sgrol pa po/ /gang zhig rtag tu mtho rangs langs nas gus pa yis/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po yid la sems byed cing*/ /bstod pa mchog 'dis dag cing gsal bar bstod byed na/ /de ni skyes pa'am ni bud med yin yang rung*/ /skye ba 'di'am ma 'ongs skye ba thams cad du/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dgos pa kun 'grub 'gyur/ /zhes po bstod nyer gcig bzla zhing*/ de'i tshe langs te phyag 'tshal ba'am/ ma nus na ma byas kyang rung la/ po bstod nyer gcig brjod pa ma lcogs na dpal ldan ye shes kyis tshar bdun bya bar bshad pa bzhin bya'o/

/bstod pa 'di ni shin tu gal che mod/ 'on kyang rnam pa thams cad du med mi rung ba'i yan lag ni ma yin te/ rgyal ba'i dbang po blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i/ smyung gnas kyi cho ga mdor bsdus pa las 'dis bstod par ma bshad pas so/ /gsum pa mjug mchog la/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter chen po/ /tshe rabs kun tu bshes mdzod la/ /sgrib sbyong lam ston dag zhing du/ / skyes nas sangs rgyas thob byin rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol gdab bya/ gtor ma gsum ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ las gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa 'khor bcas kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis 'phags pa 'khor bcas la phul nas mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ gnyis ba des chos skyong la phul nas/ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di ni chos skyong srung ma rnams la 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba dang bdag gi bar chad zhi zhing mthun rkyen 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gsum pa des gzhi bdag la phul nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod dam min kyang*/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di ni/ gzhi bdag rnams la sbyin no/ /bdag cag gi bya ba ci byas kyang ko long mi mdzad par mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas khrus ni/ me long ngos su bum pa'i chus/ mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /dri zhim bdud rtsi'i khrus gsol bas/ /bdag dang 'gro ba'i nyes pa kun/ /byang ste sku gsum thob par shog /ces khrus gsol/ yig brgya bzlas te/ bcom ldan 'das khyed la bdag gis nyes pa'i tshogs ci bgyis pa thams cad bzod par gsol gyis/

bdag la sgrib pa mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ 'phags pa nam mkhar byon nas bdag la khrus gsol bas sgrib pa thams cad dag par gyur par bsams la/ bum chu btung*/ de ltar sbyor dngos gnyis la cho ga tshar gsum gsum dgos pa'i cho ga dang po gnyis la khrus bya ste gso sbyong nas bzung tshar re dang*/ phyi ma gnyis la gso sbyong ma gtogs mjug gi khrus kyi bar tshar gnyis re bya'o/ /phyag len rgyas par gzhan du shes dgos shing*/ rjes cho ga la gso sbyong ma gtogs char gcig byas la/ rten yod na/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/ badzra muḥye shes pa dang mgron gzhan rnams gshegs shing*/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsams la shis pa brjod par bya'o/ /de dag ni mkhas pa'i man ngag la brten nas mdor bsdus te bkod pa'o/ / phyag rdor ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdo rje 'phyar stabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ nas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ lcang lo can nas gsang ba'i bdag po'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ sarba nas/ yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/

oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mthu stobs byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ sbyar ba ci nus bzla/ mjug tu yig brgya dang*/ bsngo smon bya'o/ /phyag rdor gtum po ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje gtum po sku mdog mthing nag /zhal gdangs nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gser gyi rdo rje phrag gong du 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra dmar ser 'bar zhing dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ de'i spyi bor khyung dkar po/ mgrin par khyung dmar po/ thugs kar khyung sngon po/ lte bar khyung ser po/ gsang gnas su khyung ljang khu/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros lcang lo can nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ /gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes pas bstod/ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mthu stobs nus pa thams cad drangs nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes ci nus dang*/ de'i mjug tu/ oṃ badzra ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swāhā/ zhes sbyar ba'ang ci nus bzla/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūṃ/ lan gsum dang*/ mchod bstod byas la/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon bya'o/ / rdo rje rnam 'joms ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon tu btang*/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam 'joms la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ sarba nas rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa yod na brlabs la/ oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra sogs kyis mchod la/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gzhan sems can gyi nad gdon nyams grib thams cad sbyangs/

sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug nas rang la thim par bsams la/ gzungs ring ci nus sam/ yang na gzungs thung cig shas dang*/ de yang mi spro na/ na maḥshtsaṇḍa badzra kro dha ya/ hu lu hu lu/ nas a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i gzungs thung ci nus bzlas nas yig brgya brjod pa sogs bya'o// 'di'i sgo nas byab khrus 'dod na/ bdag bskyed sngon du btang nas bum bskyed bsdus pa ni/ bum pa phyag len bzhin sta gon byas pa/ mdun du stegs kyi khar bkod/ mchod pas mtha' bskor ba/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar sngar bzhin brjod/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ mchod bstod bya/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rnam par bsdus nas sngags phreng la thim/ de las rgyu bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam la/ sngags gsum ci rigs bzlas nas yig brgya brjod/ gtor ma 'bum na/ bya rgyud ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul nas mchod bstod bya/ de nas bsgrub bya mdun du 'bod pas/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ gzungs thung tshar gcig brjod nas/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/

de bzhin du 'og ma kun la thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes sbyar te/ nad= rims= gdon= nye bar 'tshe ba= dus ma yin par 'chi ba= khon= grib= bdud= byur= skal ba ngan pa= ltas ngan pa= mtshan ma ngan pa= rmi lam ngan pa= bkra mi shis pa= mtshan ma nag mo'i gdon= bdud kyi zhags pa= gshin rje'i pho nya= bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes lan mang du brjod cing bzla'o/ /de nas khar chu cung zad bzung zhing*/ bkrus pa'i lhag ma mdun du glud bcas kyi snod bzhag pa der 'pho bar bsam la/ rma bya'i sgro chun gyi steng du nyi gdan la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis che ge mo'i nad gdon thams cad byabs shing ded par gyur/ des byabs nas/ snying po brjod pa'i rjes su/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa na ye swāhā/ de bzhin du gzhan re re'i mthar a pa na ye swāhā/ zhes brjod pa'i rjes su kha'i chu de sngar bkrus pa'i chu nang du 'pho'o/ /de nas/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ zhes sogs bden stobs kyi mjug tu/ sumbha ni brjod cing*/ yungs kar gyis brabs/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas la chu de phyi rol du 'dor/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal/ /dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las= dbang po lha min= lha min zla ba= nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni sprin las rnam par rgyal/ /rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden pa rab tu gnas/ /sa yang bden par gnas pa la/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ /bden pa rgyal gyur rdzun ma lags/ /bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig 'di dag gis che ge mo 'dud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar gyur cig dza ya dza ya sidhi sidhi pha la pha la hoḥ

zhes brjod/ de nas yang*/ na maḥshtsaṇḍa badzra nas hūṃ phaṭa/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las rakṣa rakṣa ye swāhā/ de bzhin du thams cad la'ang sbyar nas brjod cing*/ mthar rdo rje 'jog pa'am/ bzhag par mos te/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /nas ma byed cig /rakṣa rakṣa ye swāhā/ zhes dang*/ shis brjod bya'o/ /mi g.yo ba sngon po ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ tshogs zhing byed na/ thun mong du 'chad 'gyur ltar byas nas/ rgyun bshags dang tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo hūṃ yig mthing nag de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun mi g.yo ba sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs te bgegs kyi rgyal po gan rkyal du sgyel ba'i steng na bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas= sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a tsa la arghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ sku mdog sngon po ral gri zhags pa can/ /brkyangs bskums stabs kyis bdud bzhi rab tu 'joms/ /ma g.yo mi g.yo g.yo ba mi mnga' ba'i/ /bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/

oṃ badzra kū la'i sngags kyis mchod/ khyaid rnams kyis nas lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rang gi thugs kar nyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas sogs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs nus pa thams cad bsdus nas sngags 'khor la thim par bsams la/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ mthar yig brgya brjod nas mchod bstod sogs bya zhing*/ nyer bsdu byas kyang rung ngo*// rta mgrin gsang sgrub ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid paṇa chen ltar sa bon las bskyed na/ hrīḥdamar po de las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid ces sbyor khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal dbus dmar/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dkar/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu blta ba/ zhal gdangs nas mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs shing*/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ dbu re re'i steng na rta mgo ljang nag rta skad 'tsher zhing*/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phro ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭwāṃ ga gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung thung*/ gsum pa na rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang zhing chen gyi g.yang bzhis stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ khrag zhag gi thig le dang thal chen gyis byugs shing*/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i gar dgu'i nyams ldan/ sku la khro chung gi tshogs kyis gtams pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su klu'i ngo bo sprul brgyad brdzis pa'i steng na zhabs brgyad g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

'dir rgyal dbang lnga pa'i sgrub thabs su bdag bskyed rkyang pa la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas mchod bstod bya ba ma gsungs kyang*/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho dang*/ paṇa chen rin po che rnam pa gnyis kyis bshad pa ltar byas na blo dang 'tsham pas/ de ltar na/ bdag nyid kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar bya/ nang mchod dang mchod pa yang na/ oṃ padmānta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du nang mchod dang mchod rdzas rnams zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam pa can so so'i byed las kyi nus pa can du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ padmānta kṛta sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod kyang 'bul/ hūṃ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku/ /mi bzad drag sngags nga ro sgrog pa'i gsung*/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag par dka' ba'i thugs/ /khro rgyal dbang po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang gi sku'i cha rnams dang thugs ka'i nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer me 'od lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros/ rang gzhan gyi nad gdon thams cad zhi bar byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas rang la thim par bsam la/ oṃ hrīḥpadmānta krita badzra kro dha ha ya ghrī ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa ci nus dang*/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i der mi 'dra ba zhig snang yang*/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ oṃ badzra thun bhyoḥ oṃ tri ga nan badzra dza dzaḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ haṃ sha trig trig nan/ trig hur thum dzaḥmā ra ya phaṭa/ oṃ ru trig trig ru trig trig nan/ trig hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya phaṭa/

zhes pa rnams kyang bzla bar bshad/ paṇa chen kyi mngon rtogs bsdus pa gnyis las sngags snga ma kho na las mi 'byung zhing*/ der ma zad/ de gsum las zhal dang phyag mtshan sngags sogs go rim cung mi 'dra ba zhig 'byung yang mi 'gal lo/ /mjug tu yig brgya bzlas nas mchod bstod bya'o/ /rgyun pa'i mngon rtogs la ni gtor ma med kyang chog par bshad la/ bsnyen pa'i skabs yin na/ gtor ma sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ dpal rta mgrin gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ padmānta kṛta sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyi dbul/ sngar ltar phyi nang gi mchod pa phul nas bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing dngos grub ma lus pa rtsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ badzra muḥ gtor mgron rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam la shis brjod bya'o/ /'dir 'jug pa bde bar byas la/ rgyas par byed 'dod na rgyal dbang rnam pa gnyis kyis sman rag gtor gsum 'bul tshul bshad pa ltar rigs so/ / sgrol ljang ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tāṃ ljang khu de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ lang tsho dar la bab pa'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad cing*/

g.yon thugs kar mtheb srin gyis utpa la'i yu ba nas bzung ba'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad du kha bye ba/ dbu skra mthon mthing phyed thor cog gi tshul du bcings shing lhag ma'i zar bu sku stod du 'phyang ba/ dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs g.yas brkyangs/ g.yon bskum pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas 'od 'phros/ po ta la nas 'phags ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ sgrol bstod 'don pa gtso bor byed na/ de nyid rje btsun ma dngos yin par mos la/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa nas/ nyi shu rtsa gcig zhes pa'i bar nyer gcig sogs brjod pa'i mthar/ rje btsan 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa bya/ gtso bor mi byed na/ tshar gcig gam/yang na/ rgyas btab ma thag oṃ ārya tā re sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod la/ lha dang lha min sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod/ de gnyis gang byed kyang*/ mthar/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rje btsun ma rang la thim pas/ rang nyid pad zla'i gdan la rje btsun ma'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tāṃ yig gi mthar bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi rigs thams cad bsal/ sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad rje btsun ma'i sku'i tshogs dang 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/

mthar yig brgya dang*/ mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ dge ba 'di yis sogs kyi bsngo smon bya'o/ / sgrol dkar ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba gur bla re/ me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su baṃ las pad dkar dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du tāṃ yig dkar po las utpa la tāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon dkon mchog gsum mtshon gyi phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ gnyis ka'ang utpa la sngon pos mdzes pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can dpral ba dang phyag zhabs kyi mthil na spyan re re mnga' ba/ dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa'i spyi bor rigs bdag tu tshe dpag med bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mdzes par gsol ba/ mtshan dpes spras shing zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs/ dza:hūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas yar lud pa las tshe dpag med dang dbyer med du 'dres te dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ārya tā re sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las gcig bsdus nas/ /lha mo'i gzugs su rab shar ba/ /tshe dang ye shes rtsol mdzad pa'i/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ snod bcud kyi yon tan dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug

spyi bo'i tshe dpag med kyi sku'i cha dang phyag gi bum par thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tshe dang bsod nams 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yuḥpuṣtiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ yig brgya 'don pa sogs bya'o/ /snga ma dang 'di la dmigs skor mi 'dra ba snang yang 'dir paṇa chen gong ma'i bzhed pa bzhin bkod do/ / rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhruṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje bhruṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas zhal ser/ g.yon zhal sngon po yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje/ gnyis pas 'od dpag med/ gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas te zhags pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pas mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ g.yas rnga yab dkar po dang g.yon padma dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yon du gsang ba'i bdag po sngon po g.yas rnga yab dkar po dang*/ g.yon rdo rjes mtshan pa'i utpal sngon po bsnams pa/ gnyis ka'ang zhi ba'i nyams can/ rin po che dang dar gyis mdzes shing zla ba'i gdan du bzhengs nas gtso bo la phyogs pa'o/ /shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri/

lhor 'dod rgyal g.yas lcags kyu/ nub tu dbyug sngon can g.yas dbyug pa/ byang du stobs po che g.yas rdo rje/ thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ dbu skra dang sma ra 'bar zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na nyi gdan la g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ steng gi cha la g.yas g.yon du gnas gtsang ma'i lha bu gnyis ser po/ lha'i dar gyis brgyan cing*/ phyag gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bzung nas gtso mo la khrus gsol ba/ thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas gtso mo la rnam snang sogs rang gi rigs bdag so sos rgyas btab par gyur/ oṃ ārya uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūṃ swāhā/ sogs kyis mchod la/ dpal ldan lha mo zhes sogs dang*/ rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyig sngon stobs po che/ gnas gtsang lha 'i bu dang bcas pa yi/ /rnam rgyal lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pas bstod/ rang gi thugs kar zla gdan gyi steng du bhruṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi las kyi sgrib pa ma lus pa sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad dang snod bcud kyi nus pa'i yon tan thams cad 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ gzungs ring ci nus dang*/ oṃ bhruṃ swāhā/ zhes snying po dang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā yurdāḥde swāhā/ zhes nye snying ci nus bzlas na las sgrib dag nas tshe dang bsod nams sogs 'thob par 'gyur ro/

/mjug tu yig brgya dang*/ mchod bstod bsngo smon bya'o// dbyangs can dkar mo ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yon pas pi wang rgyud stong dang ldan pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yas pa'i phyag sor gyis mngon par brdung pa la brtson pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ dbu skra mthon mthing phyed grol ba'i zar bus sku stod khebs shing phyed thor cog tu byas pa'i rtse mor me tog gis bcings pa la rin po che dang zla ba phyed pas mdzes pa/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na zhabs gnyis cog pur bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas hūṃ mthing kha/ de las 'od 'phros/ lho phyogs dri za dga' ba'i tshal nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang rang gi snying gyen du bgreng ba'i nang du srog gi ngo bo aṃ dkar po/ de'i nā da las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu dbugs dang lhan cig sna bug g.yas pa nas 'phros/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i shangs bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ de'i shes rab kyi 'khor lo la reg pas/ lcags kyus 'then pa bzhin du shangs bug g.yas pa nas 'thon/ mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ oṃ swa ra swa sti arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ 'dir bstod pa mi snang dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'od kyi rnam par rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ aṃ yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang gi snying khong stong gi nang du pad dkar 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hrīṃḥdakar po/

'dab ma brgyad la dbyangs yig gnyis gnyis te bcu drug gis bskor ba las 'od zer mar me'i phreng ba ltar dkar zhing gsal ba 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang*/ mi shes pa'i mun pa gsal/ ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mkhyen rabs thams cad bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃḥ zhes pa bdud sogs ci nus dang*/ de nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīṃḥgi nā da las hrīṃḥre re chad rang gi zhal nas thon/ lte bar zhugs/ mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis mi shes pa'i rmongs pa thams cad bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba khyad par can thob par bsam la/ hrīṃḥ brgya stong khri 'bum sogs bzla/ yang skabs der skye 'phags thams cad kyi shes bar tshur sdud pa'i dmigs pa dang*/ khyad par thun 'jog pa'i tshe bya'o/ / 'di la ma grub na spog

chog zhig gsungs kyang ma bris/ bgegs zlog pa la khro bo gang rung dang*/ dbul ba sel ched nor lha yang bsgoms na legs par gsung*/ mthar yig brgya bzla ba dang*/ bsngo smon bya'o/ /gtor 'bul 'og nas thun mong du 'chad par 'gyur ro// gdugs dkar ni/ skyabs sems sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ shūn+ya tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can tog la oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo can sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ cung zad khro zhing 'dzum pa/ 'di la phyag mtshan gyi ngo bo dang go rim cung mi 'dra ba snang yang rgyal dbang ltar byas na/ g.yas gsum rim pa bzhin 'khor lo lcags kyu gzhu/ g.yon gsum rim pa bzhin/ rdo rje mda' zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub can/ dbu skra gnag snum ral pa'i thor tshugs dang lhag ma lan bur 'phyang ba/ nu 'bur rgyas shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ 'od phung 'phro ba'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ dang sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo can la rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ uṣṇī ṣa si ta tā pa tre arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ rgyal ba kun gyi mtshan mchog gtsug tor nas/ / legs par 'khrungs pa'i rmad byung lha mo ni/ /gzhan gyis mi thub gtsug tor gdugs dkar zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs kar zla gdan la oṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus nas rang nyid la thi par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇī ṣa si ta tā pa tre hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes dang*/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ bai re bai re/ badzra dha ri bhandha bhandha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ gzhan sngags mi 'dra ba zhig kyang snang*/ mjug tu yig brgya bzlas nas/ mchod bstod bsngo smon bya'o// lo ma gyon ma ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid baṃ ser po/ de las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid ri khrod lo ma gyon ma sku mdog ljang ser/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ljang ser/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ me tog dmar po'i thod dang ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa/ phyag g.yas gsum rim pa bzhin rdo rje dgra sta mda'/ g.yon gsum rim pa bzhin sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa shing lo'i chun po/ gzhu bsnams pa/ shing lo gshibs pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag pags kyi sham thabs can rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas pus mo dang g.yon pa'i mthil gyis zla gdan la bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ sarba nas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ārya parṇa sha wa ri arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i baṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon thams cad zhi bar byas/

rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ oṃ pi shā tse parṇa sha wa ri sarba dzwa ra pra sha ma na ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla ba dang yig brgya 'don pa sogs bya'o/ /'di'i mngon rtogs la mi 'dra ba'ang snang ngo*// lha mo 'od zer can ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phag ser po bdun gyis drangs pa'i khri'i steng du baṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su māṃ ser po las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid lha mo 'od zer can sku mdog ser po/ sku sha skem pa/ gcer mo rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ 'od kyi phung po'i dbus na/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas rnam snang gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ārya mā ri tsyai arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gang gi mtshan tsam bzung bas kyang/ /mi mthun 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /re ba yid bzhin skong mdzad ma/ /'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ rang gi thugs kar zla gdan gyi steng du māṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ ba spu'i sgo nas phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi bar byas/ rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ oṃ mā ri tsyai māṃ swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas na 'jigs tshogs las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar yig brgya brjod pa sogs bya'o/ /'di la mngon rtogs mi 'dra ba mang*//

khro gnyer can ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i steng du bhṛṃ po las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo khro gnyer can sku mdog ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis rin po che'i dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor cog can/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa'i rin po che dang lha rdzas kyi gos sna tshogs pas spras pa/ 'od zer 'phro ba'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ārya bhṛṃ ku ṭi arghaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ma lus pa/ /gcig bsdus lha mo'i gzugs su shar/ /dran pas dngos grub mchog rtsol ba'i/ /khro gnyer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad drangs nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ oṃ bhṛṃ swāhā/ zhes bzlas nas yig brgya brjod pa sogs bya'o// rig byed ma ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo rig byed ma dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis utpala'i mda' gzhu 'gengs shing*/ 'og ma gnyis skyabs sbyin dang utpal 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ 'od dmar ser gyis bskor ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyangs nas bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/
