nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ nas 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ku ru ku le arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ sku mdog dmar mo mda' gzhu 'gengs/ /khams gsum skye 'gro dbang du sdud/ /dran pa yis kyang 'dod pa'i don/ /'gugs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras bcas kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ ku ru ku le hrīṃḥswāhā/ ci nus bzla zhing*/ gang 'dod pa'i bsgrub bya de 'gugs pa'i dmigs pa byas na dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mthar yig brgya bzla ba sogs bya'o// nor rgyun ma ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs byas nas/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du baṃ ser po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ lang tsho rgyas shing rin po che dang dar sna tshogs kyis klubs pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'bru'i snye ma dang rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ 'ja' zer 'khrigs pa'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ nas 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ nas rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ba su dha ri arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma/ /dpal dang 'byor ba'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma/ /yid la re ba'i bkra shis rtsol mdzad ma/ /lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i paṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis srid pa gsum gyi 'dod rgu thams cad kyang rgyal ba sras bcas kyi byin rlabs dang lhan cig bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/

oṃ ba su dha ri ni swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas na dbul ba sel bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar yig brgya bzla ba sogs bya'o// 'dzam la ser po ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du dzaṃ ser po las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus dzaṃ yig la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dzambha la ser po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas bi dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ utpala'i phreng ba can/ lha'i dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing*/ zhabs phyed skyil gyis dung dang padma'i gter mnan pa'i spyi bor oṃ nas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ sarba nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ārya dzambha las pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*/ /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzambha la/ /dngos grub mchog rtsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs kar zla dkyil gyi steng du dzaṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul 'phongs zhi bar byas/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ oṃ dzambha la dza lend+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus dang*/ mthar yig brgya bzlas nas mchod bstod sogs bya'o/ /gtor ma 'bul na/ 'og nas 'chad pa ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ spyan drangs la phul te/ mchod bstod byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la 'dod rgu'i dngos grub ma lus pa rtsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ bzod pa gsol nas/ gshegs gsol bya'o// 'di'i chu sbyin byed par 'dod na yo byad sta gon bya ste/

de yang sku yod na zangs gzhong dung zhag la/ bsangs sbyangs rang nyid zhes pa'i tshig 'dor ba ma gtogs gong ltar bskyed la dbang bskur rgyas 'debs mchod bstod kyi bar bya/ de nas/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba yi/ phyag mthil zla bar bhruṃ aṃ dziṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ rnams las rigs lnga bdud rtsir zhu ba'i chu/ mdzub mo las babs dzaṃ lha'i dbu la 'bul/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza lend+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags brgya rtsa bzla zhing chu sbreng*/ mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi dbul 'phongs kyi sdug bsngal zhi nas longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ bzod gsol sogs bya'o// dzaṃ lha dkar po'i chu sbyin byed par 'dod pas/ yo byad sta gon byas te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs kha sarba ṇir gsal bar gyur par bsams la/ mdun du rten yod dam med kyang*/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzaṃ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can rnams kyi dbul 'phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la sku mdog gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la chags pa'i nyams can yid tsam khros pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes shing sma ra dang smin ma kham ser du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i be con bsnams pa/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ dar gyi yug gon stod g.yogs kyi tshul du 'phyang ba/ pañtsa li ka'i sham thabs can g.yu 'brug gi steng na zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ de'i shar gyi 'dab ma la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje ḍā ki ma nam mkha'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pas rten 'brel gyi nor rdzas bsnams pa/ lhor trāṃ las rin po che'i trāṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rin chen ḍā ki ma ser mo g.yas nor bu rin po che dang g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu baṃ las padma baṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ padma ḍā ki ma dmar mo g.yas padma dang g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ byang du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las/ las kyi ḍā ki ma ljang khu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang*/ g.yon ne'u le nor bu skyugs pa bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa'i dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa gtso 'khor lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang*/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi rigs bdag kyis dbu brgyan par gyur par bsams la/ gtsang zhing dri med rgyan ldan chu phul ba/ /mu tig phreng bar gyur nas gtso 'khor gyi/ /sku gang zug rngu zhi zhing bde dang ldan/ / zhal nas mu tig dngos grub char rgyun phob/ /zhes gsol ba btab ste chu gtsang zangs gzhong du sbreng zhing*/ oṃ padma kro dha ārya dzaṃ bha la hraṃ da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i sngags brgya rtsa bzla/ de nas mchod pa yod na byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ padma kro dha ārya dzaṃ bha la sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ shel dkar zhun ma'i phung po dbang gzhu yis/ /rab dkris gar dgu'i nyams ldan gnod sbyin dbang*/ /'dod dgu'i dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan dzaṃ bha la la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes bstod/ rten yod na/ 'di nyid gzugs dang zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/

med na/ badzra muḥye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ chu mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce thog tu bzhag ste dngos grub blang*/ chu cung zad re phyogs bzhir gtor zhing yig brgya bzla/ lhag ma la longs spyad do// seng gdong ma ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs byas la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid hūṃ las gri gug hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ mgrin pa yan seng ge khros pa lta bu dkar po/ man chad mthing nag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i mchan khung na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs shing*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pa brla la brten cing*/ g.yon brkyangs pa'i gar stabs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba dang dbang lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ sidha mu kha sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la bstod/ ye shes pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ sarba nas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od drag tu 'phros gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mthu stobs nus pa thams cad bkug nas rang nyid la thim par bsams la/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭa/

zhes bzlas la/ thal mo nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du brlag pa'i dmigs pas/ bla ma yang dag pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas= chos= dge 'dun= yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi= ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs kyi bden pa dang bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ lo zla zhag gsum gyi skeg dang rmi lam ltos mtshan ngan pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dgra bgegs mi ma yin la sogs pa'i gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad zlog par gyur cig /med par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cigaces lan gsum mam gcig brjod la thal mo brdab bo/

/ gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad nyer zhi zhing*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*/ /zhes sogs brjod do// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg ni/ til dang me sta gon byas la/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang*/ me a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su hūṃ las rdo rje/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'ching ba/ zhal gnam du gdangs shing*/ mche ba rnon po bzhi gtsigs pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ stag shams gsol zhing*/ zhabs gnyis zlum por bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badzra ḍā ka sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i snying khar sdig pa'i sa bon paṃ nag po/ lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po/ rkang mthil gnyis su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po/ paṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad 'od zer nag po'i rnam par bkug nas paṃ yig la thim/ 'og gi rlung g.yos rkang mthil nas zhugs/ lte ba'i me sbar/ de'i 'od kyis snying kha'i paṃ yig ded de sna sgo nas thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas til la thim pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol bar gyur par bsams la/

oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha ga khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhaṣmiṃ ku ru swāhā/ bdag gi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod pa dang til mer 'dor ba mnyam du byed cing grangs skabs dang sbyar/ mjug tu mchod bstod sngar bzhin byas la/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gcig gis bzod gsol byas/ oṃ badzra muḥye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas me 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ ces brjod cing*/ me ma shi'i bar me la mi reg cing shi nas kyang thal ba gtsang sar bskyal lo/ /'di ltar lan mang du byas na sdig ltung spyi dang dam tshig nyams pa sogs kyi nyes pa 'dag cing*/ bar gcod bzlog pa la yang bsngags so/ /zhes rje yab sras kyi man ngag las 'byung ngo*/ / khyung khra ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs byas la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan gyi steng du klu'i rgyal po sog ma med gan rkyal du sgyel ba'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid khroṃ ljang sngon/ de las 'od 'phros/ gdon rigs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje khyung khra bo sna tshogs pa'i sku mdog can/ brla gnyis sa'i rang bzhin ser po/ lto ba chu'i rang bzhin dkar po/ stod me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ mgo bo rlung gi rang bzhin nag po/ spyi bo dang gshog pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin kha dog sna tshogs pa/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin can gyi mchu dang rwa shin tu rno ba/ rwa bar na yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ phrag pa g.yas g.yon na nyi zlas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad cing*/ sprin phung la sku rgyab brten nas zhabs gnyis tsog pu'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ mgrin par padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su sangs rgyas kyi khyung dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ shar du rdo rje'i khyung sngon po g.yas rdo rje/

lhor rin po che'i khyung ser po g.yas rin po che/ nub tu padma'i khyung dmar po g.yas padma/ byang du las kyi khyung ljang khu g.yas ral gri 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thams cad rang rang gi kha dog can gyi sbrul bzung nas za ba/ rwa dang mchu sder shin tu ma bzad pa dang ldan pa/ thugs kar pad 'dab bzhi la khyung lnga'i ngo bo/ dbus su oṃ dkar po/ shar du ba sngon po/ lhor kṣi ser po/ nub tu swā dmar po/ byang du hā ljang khu/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi khyung spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ= slar yang nas rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa yod na/ oṃ badzra ga ru ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ nas rol mo rnams/ bde stong rnam pa mchod rdzas byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du bde ba khyad par can ster bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badzra ga ru ḍa arghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod la/ rigs lnga'i klu 'dul rdo rje'i gshog sgro ldan/ /nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms pa'i sgra chen sgrog /ye shes lnga ldan mkha' lding dbang po la/ yan lag lngas 'dud gdon gsum zhi bar brjod/ rang gi mgrin pa'i khyung dang*/ snying kha'i yi ge las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros pa'i sne las khyung lnga'i tshogs 'phros/ klu dang sa bdag gi gdon dang dug thams cad bcom/ slar 'dus so so la thim par gyur/ bar bsams la/ oṃ pa kṣiṃ swāhā/ 'bum phrag sogs bzla'o/ /snying khar yang khyung lnga dgod pa dkyul las bzlog nas bshad kyang mi 'gal la/ las tshogs ni sa skya gong ma'i gsung las rgyas par 'byung zhing*/ mngon rtogs cung mi 'dra ba'ang yod do/ /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/

bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ yi ge gsum lan gsum brjod de/ 'od zer gyis nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra ga ru ḍā i daṃ sogs kyis phul/ mchod bstod byas la/ gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs gsol bya'o// khyung nag ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du btang la/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dug gi rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su mthong dug reg dug tshor dug sogs dug rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dug gi ri rab gru bzhi ba'i steng du sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma/ de'i steng du gdon gsum khrir brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ rang nyid rdo rje mkha' lding nag po gnam lcags kyi mchu sder mi bzad pa dang ldan pa/ rtsa ba rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang rtse mo rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rang bzhin can gyi rwa 'bar ba gnyis kyi dbus su nor bus mtshan pa/ gser mig 'khyil pa nyi ltar 'bar ba/ zhal dung so ngar mas gang zhing gshog pa rdo rje'i ri mo can las me'i tsha tsha 'bum phrag 'phro ba/ mgrin pa nas pus mo'i bar mi'i rnam pa la rkang pa bya'i sder mo can/ sku las me mdag dang bcas pa'i gnam lcags dang*/ khyung nag du ma phyogs bcur 'phro bas sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad brgyal zhing dngangs par byed pa/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ nas hūṃ las 'od 'phros bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje mkha' lding nag po oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ badzra ga ru ḍa arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ stong gsum g.yo ba'i gshog sgro yis/ /gar mdzad 'bar ba'i mchu sder can/ /dran pa tsam gyis gdon gsum kun/ /tshar gcod mkha' lding dbang por bstod/ /rang gi snying kha'i nyi gdan gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer bskal pa'i me dpung lta bu 'bar zhing mched pas brtan g.yo'i snod bcud thams cad me 'bar ba'i klong du gyur cing*/

steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs bar bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi khyung khyung*/ thuṃ thuṃ rbad rbad swāhā/ zhes zhi ba'i sngags cung zad bzlas nas/ nag po kā la rakṣa rbad rbad/ sod sod/ phyung phyung*/ spu gre zang zang*/ lcags kyi sder mos snying phyung*/ gnod byed gdug pa'i sha la zo/ oṃ lhang lhang*/ tser tser/ 'ub 'ub sod/ zhes pa 'bum mam gang la bzla/ gdon srung na/ skud pa nag po la mdud pa bdun byas la sngags gdab/ mdud pa'i nang du khyung re re bzhugs par bsams la/ rang nyid khyung du gsal bas 'dogs/ ser ba srung na rang khyung du gsal bas sngags bzlas la ser ba phyogs su phus btab pas/ khyung gi nam mkha' gang zhing ser ba bskrad pa dang*/ khyung rnams las me 'bar bas ser ba zhu bar bsams pa gang rigs bya/ yang yungs kar thal ba bye ma sogs la sngags btab ste/ ser ba phyogs su gtor bar bya'o/ / da ni gong du smos pa'i sgrub thabs de dag gi skabs su skyabs 'gro rgyas tsam dang tshogs zhing byas nas bzlas pa'i mthar gtor ma yang 'phul bar 'dod na/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhes pa nas dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam de dang de'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dpal mgon dam pa nas spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan gsum dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lha de dang de'i sgom bzlas la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum/ rang nyid skad cig gis lha de dang der gyur/ tshogs zhing dang bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa thun mong du byin rlabs bya ba ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ lha de dang de la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ 'jam dbyangs la mtshon na/ oṃ ārya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra sogs sam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la bstod/ spro na/ yan lag bdun pa yang bya/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms te dngos gzhi la 'jug go /bzlas pa'i tshe dang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'don par bsams na 'gyur che bar bshad la/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni phal cher la sum 'bum dang*/ ma mtha'ang 'bum phrag gcig bya dgos so/ /mthar gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed de/ dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas 'debs rnams byas la gtor ma phul nas mchod bstod bya/ 'on kyang phyi ma 'di bde bas/ gtor ma amṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ mchod pa sngar bzhin byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha de dang de la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ padma ka ma la ye st+waṃ/ lha de dang de 'khor bcas kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ 'jam dbyangs lta bu la/ oṃ ārya mañdzu shrī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ pa liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes rang rang gi mtshan sbyar te lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul ba'am/ yang na/ a kā ros phul nas mchod bstod byas la bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba gdab/ badzra muḥ gtor mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod la bsngo smon sogs bya'o/ / gtor ma mi 'bul tshe/ sgrub thabs ltar ram/ rgyal dbang gis yig brgya bzlas pa'i rjes su/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas zhal rang la phyogs te bzhugs par bsams la/ mchod bstod gsol 'debs byed par gsungs pa bzhin byas na'ang legs so// chos skyong gi gtor 'bul bsdus pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhes pa nas bzhengs par gyur par bsam la/ nang mchod dang gtor ma sogs yod na bcu gsum ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ bsdu na/ gtor ma/ hrīḥṣtīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ āḥlas mi mgo sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'khol/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams bkug ste yi ge gsum la thim/ thod par lhung nas zhu bas rdzas rnams sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum byas pa'i zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ mchod pa gzhan rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas rnams bde stong rnam pa mchod rdzas byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed pas sa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ gnyis ka thun mong du byed na nang mchod dang mchod rdzas zhes sbyor/ de las kyang 'jug pa bde bar 'dod na/ rang nyid 'jigs mdzad zhal gcig phyag gnyis par/ /gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/

/mchod gtor kun gyi nyes skyon sbyangs shing sbar/ zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum mam gcig brjod/ rgyas bsdus de gang rung gi phro nas 'di ltar/ dzaḥrang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /yi dam bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dad pas*/ na drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod dang*/ /lho phyogs mi bzad lcags kyi grong khyer nas/ /myur mdzad mgon po dam can chos kyi rgyal/ /'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /byang shar mu le ding gi khrag mtsho dang*/ /byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas/ /'dod khams dbang phyug rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dpung bcas gnas 'dir gshegs/ /'jigs rung ha ha rgod pa la sogs dang*/ /byang shar ma ru tse yi dur khrod nas/ /dpal ldan bram ze mgon po yum chen bzhi/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang dang padma thod phreng gi /spyan sngar thub bstan srung bar dam bcas pa/ /tha 'og chos kyi rgyal po chen po sogs/ /chos skyong 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs/ /bde stong dbyer med lha yi lam yangs par/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung 'khrigs gyur pa/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga/ /yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /khyad par zag med dam rdzas gtor ma'i tshogs/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang bcas te/ dngos bshams yid sprul ma tshang med par yang*/ /yi dam bstan srung rgya mtsho 'khor bcas mchod/ /khyad par man gsum brjod na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor dgon gnas sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi mthun kun zhi mthun rkyen 'grub par mdzod/

/hūṃ/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang dpal ldan ye shes mgon/ /'jam dpal bka' nyan las gshin chos kyi rgyal/ /'dod khams dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /mthu stobs bdag po rnam mang thos pa'i sras/ /he ru ka dpal bram ze dpa' bo'i gzugs/ /sgrol gying drag po srog bdag dmar po dang*/ /gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas bstod par bgyi/ /rdo rje 'chang sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ /rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa'i/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams rtag tu bstod/ /mchog gsum bstan srung rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod pas rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi/ /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /mthun pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /rten yod na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ / zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/ nyes kun bzod bzhes rang bzhin gnas su gshegs/ /slar yang byon nas mchog thun dngos grub rtsol/ / dam chos sgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang*/ /dus rnams kun tu dge legs 'phel bar mdzod/ /bslab pa gsum ldan sogs brjod par bya'o/ / smras pa/ dngos grub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog yang dag gi /sgrub thabs 'dod rgu'i gter chen po/ /mkhas pa'i bzhed srol ji bzhin bkod/ /'di la nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na/ /mchog gsum dam pa'i spyan sngar 'chags/ /legs par bshad las thob pa'i dge /bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /zhes yi dam sgrub skor 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i za ma tog ces bya ba 'di ni/ dpon chen gong ma'i rigs brgyud du 'khrungs shing mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs dang rig gnas du ma la rnam dpyod yangs pa/ ko'u shri nang so'i bka' bzhin co ne'i sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa zung 'brel gyis skyong khul du gnas pa shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyis slob dpon sems dpa' chen po blo
